args.title: Document report field limits in the API reference
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The Reports section lists the fields of `POST /reports` and the shape of `schedule` but omits their limits. Add: `name` is 1-120 characters, `categories` is an array of at most 50 strings (each 1-60 characters), and `schedule.recipients` is an array of 1-20 email addresses. These limits come from the zod schemas in src/api/reports.ts and apply to both POST /reports and PATCH /reports/:id.

The validation limits are real but undocumented: in src/api/reports.ts, `name` must be 1-120 characters, `categories` is capped at 50 entries (each 1-60 characters), and `schedule.recipients` must have 1-20 email addresses. Opened a PR to add these to the Reports section of docs/API.md.
